data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store in the UK, I'd put **Stripe, Shopify Payments and PayPal** at the top of the list.

My overall recommendation is **Stripe** if you want flexibility, competitive payment processing and the ability to grow without changing providers.

However, the best choice depends on whether you're selling through Shopify, WooCommerce, or your own website.

## Best payment processors compared

*Indicative UK online card fees, November 2026. Check provider pricing before signing up.*

| Provider | Best for | Typical UK fee |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Stripe | Best overall for online stores | 1.5% + 20p |
| Shopify Payments | Shopify stores | Depends on plan |
| Square | Simplicity and online/in-person sales | 1.4% + 25p |
| PayPal | Customer familiarity and trust | Around 2.9% + 30p |
| GoCardless | Subscriptions and recurring payments | 1% + 20p |


Sources: [www.businessexpert.co.uk](https://www.businessexpert.co.uk/payment-processing/best-online-payment-solutions/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.intelivita.co.uk](https://www.intelivita.co.uk/blog/best-online-payment-gateways?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[whito.co.uk](https://whito.co.uk/tools/best-payment-processors-for-uk-businesses/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My top three recommendations

![Stripe Logo Download (SVG, PNG, EPS, PDF) | PixelBrands](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aVtuLxJXV9DmtEmg9b45Apl_aIYsif99dM-GHSfkXYZDC4tFOhFvFlTrHocFw_PqD4iGlfn8TyGj8Knz3iEfgQ88Gl1qbf-qVS8yq3s_dga8IuVvdS85dQWTHuxQAfDBHQSn4bvLAWea6XSgqDlmrU-sz5LlptntGZmOFqqabVil8_uydbbIqAvaqwgrj-k8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe — best overall**

- No standard monthly fee.
- Easy integration with WooCommerce and custom websites.
- Apple Pay, Google Pay and subscription payments.
- Good fraud-prevention tools.

Website: [Stripe UK](https://stripe.com/gb)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments — best for Shopify**

- Integrated directly into Shopify.
- No need to manage a separate payment gateway.
- Avoids Shopify's additional third-party transaction fees.

Website: [Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/uk/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal — best additional checkout option**

- Familiar to many online shoppers.
- Allows customers to pay using their PayPal balance.
- Useful as an additional option alongside card payments.

Website: [PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/uk/business)

## What I'd choose

For most small online stores, I'd use Stripe as the main payment processor and offer PayPal as an additional checkout option.

If the store runs on Shopify, I'd use Shopify Payments instead.

## Three questions to narrow it down

Wix / Squarespace

---

**3\. Where are most of your customers?**
